title: Show HN: NanoMuse – An open-source AI agent for your phone and computer
summary: NanoMuse is a lightweight, open-source AI agent designed to work across mobile devices and computers, enabling users to access AI assistance on multiple platforms with an emphasis on minimal resource usage and open-source accessibility.
problem_solved: Provides a lightweight, cross-platform open-source AI agent that users can run on their phones and computers without heavy dependencies.
why_valuable: Its open-source nature and cross-platform support democratize access to AI agents while giving users full control over their data and customization options.
